title: Working on New UI
body: Completely hand-written, no UI library. It takes time, but it'll fix many UI/UX issues you might be facing. Please be patient and I hope it will be worth the wait!

title: AppImage shows a blank white screen on Linux
body: If you are using the AppImage on Linux and see a blank white screen, this is due to a linuxdeploy issue affecting most Tauri-based apps. You can fix it by running the following command in the terminal before launching the app (replace the path if your libwayland-client.so.0 is located elsewhere). This is a known issue and will be fixed as soon as the linuxdeploy contributors fix it. You can also use the .rpm or .deb versions, which work completely fine. I apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
